# IFontStyle — interface · 28 members
How text is drawn: its typeface, size, weight, slant, lines, color, spacing and baseline.

- `getFamily(): string` — Returns the typeface drawn: the one stated, or the theme's font when the style names a theme font or none.
- `setFamily(family: string | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle` — Sets the typeface: a family name, or a IFontStyle.ThemeFamily to follow the theme's heading or body font.
- `getThemeFamily(): IFontStyle.ThemeFamily | null` — Returns the theme font the style follows, or `null` when it names its own family.
- `getFallbacks(): string[]` — Returns the families drawn when IFontStyle.getFamily cannot draw a character, in order.
- `setFallbacks(fallbacks: string[] | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle`
- `getSize(): number` — Returns the size in points.
- `setSize(size: number | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle` — Sets the size in points.
- `getWeight(): number` — Returns the weight, `400` being regular and `700` bold.
- `setWeight(weight: number | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle`
- `getBold(): boolean` — Returns whether the text is bold: a weight above `400`.
- `setBold(bold: boolean | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle` — Sets the weight to bold (`700`) or regular (`400`).
- `getItalic(): boolean` — Returns whether the text is italic.
- `setItalic(italic: boolean | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle`
- `getUnderline(): IFont.UnderlineStyle` — Returns how the text is underlined; `'none'` when it is not.
- `setUnderline(underline: IFont.UnderlineStyle | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle` — Sets how the text is underlined; `'none'` removes the underline.
- `getStrike(): IFont.StrikeStyle` — Returns how the text is struck through; `'none'` when it is not.
- `setStrike(strike: IFont.StrikeStyle | null, options?: ITransaction.OperationOptions): IFontStyle` — Sets how the text is struck through;…[truncated]
